sky arts.desc: New. Sibelius' four-movement orchestral work is famous for its sunny pastoral themes, dramatic tension and triumphant finale. With the London Philharmonic Orchestra. (2 of 5)

sky arts.title: Amadeus
sky arts.desc: In 1788, Amadeus debuts 'Don Giovanni', inspired by his father's death. Meanwhile, Salieri moves to finally seal Mozart's fate. (4 of 5)

sky arts.title: Dickens In Italy With David Harewood
sky arts.desc: David Harewood investigates the impact Italy had on Charles Dickens, discovering that the quintessentially English author was far more cosmopolitan than expected.

sky cinema premiere.title: The Pout-Pout Fish
sky cinema premiere.desc: Two aquatic misfits embark on an impossible journey to save their home.

sky cinema premiere.title: My Christmas Cowboy
sky cinema premiere.desc: Years after a college newsroom mishap sent Meg and Billy down opposite life paths, they reunite in a small Texas town to save an annual holiday event.

sky cinema premiere.title: The End of Oak Street
sky cinema premiere.desc: When a cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and drops it into the unknown, the Platt family soon discover that their survival depends on sticking together in an alien landscape.

sky cinema action.title: The Running Man
sky cinema action.desc: Desperate for money to save his sick daughter, Ben Richards joins the top-rated show on television, "The Running Man," a deadly competition where contestants must survive 30 days while being hunted by professional assassins.

sky cinema action.title: Jurassic Park III
sky cinema action.desc: Dr Alan Grant reluctantly accompanies a rich couple who are searching for their teenage son who crashed on the second Jurassic Park island while paragliding. Unfortunately for the adventurers, there are many unfamiliar - and deadly - dinosaurs lurking in the jungle.

sky cinema action.title: xXx
sky cinema action.desc: An extreme sports junkie is blackmailed by the CIA into taking on a highly dangerous mission to Prague in order to thwart the plans of a group of Russian extremists. The reluctant hero soon finds himself with the safety of the USA in his hands - and a complicated romance on the horizon.

sky cinema action.title: xXx: The Return of Xander Cage
sky cinema action.desc: After coming out of self-imposed exile, daredevil operative Xander Cage must race against time to recover a sinister weapon known as Pandora's Box, a device that controls every military satellite in the world. Recruiting a new group of thrill-seeking cohorts, Xander finds himself entangled in a deadly conspiracy that points to collusion at the highest levels of government.

sky cinema family.title: Karate Kid: Legends
sky cinema family.desc: After moving to New York City, kung fu prodigy Li Fong enters a karate competition -- but his skills alone aren't enough. With help from Mr. Han and Daniel LaRusso, he soon learns to merge two styles into one for the ultimate martial arts showdown.

sky cinema family.title: Dog Man
sky cinema family.desc: A life-saving surgery fuses together a police officer and his faithful police dog -- and Dog Man is born. Learning to embrace his new identity, Dog Man must stop feline supervillain Petey the Cat from cloning himself and going on a crime spree.

sky cinema family.title: The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie
sky cinema family.desc: There's trouble brewing in Bikini Bottom. Someone has stolen King Neptune's crown, and it looks like Mr Krab, SpongeBob's boss, is the culprit. Though he's just been passed over for the promotion of his dreams, SpongeBob stands by his boss, and along with his best pal Patrick, sets out on a treacherous mission to Shell City to reclaim the crown and save Mr Krab's life.

sky cinema family.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
sky cinema family.desc: SpongeBob goes on a quest to discover a stolen recipe that takes him to our world, where he tangles with a pirate.

sky cinema comedy.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
sky cinema comedy.desc: Tale about an unconventional sleuth's attempts to find a football team's stolen mascot dolphin. The Miami Dolphins are aghast when their beloved Snowflake is abducted one week before the all-important Super Bowl, so they call in Ace Ventura, a private eye who uses unorthodox methods to retrieve missing animals.

sky cinema comedy.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
sky cinema comedy.desc: Sequel about the zany private detective who specialises in locating missing pets. Ace Ventura travels to Africa to search for a kidnapped sacred albino bat, which reputedly has the power to restore peace between two warring tribes.

sky cinema comedy.title: Police Academy
sky cinema comedy.desc: Misfits realise their dreams of becoming cops when a mayoral decree forces the police academy to open its doors to all.

sky cinema comedy.title: Police Academy 2: Their First Assignment
sky cinema comedy.desc: Mahoney and friends have graduated from the Police Academy and are issued with their first assignments. As before, their cheerfulness and devotion to duty outweighs any shortcomings, but are they ready to do battle with a band of graffiti daubing terrorists?

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Waterworld
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Big-budget tale of the battle for survival in a world where dry land has disappeared with the melting of the polar ice caps. One man, who has become amphibious, tries to protect survivors on an artificial atoll made from scrap metal by taking on a gang of marauding pirates. He is also intent on discovering if there is any truth in the myth that there is still some land left above water.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Men in Black
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: The secretive Men in Black are agents charged with regulating the aliens who have settled on Earth and ensure that they remain undetected. New recruit J and his partner K must find and stop an intergalactic terrorist bent on assassinating two ambassadors from opposing galaxies before they can make peace.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Men in Black II
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Sequel to the sci-fi comedy about a top secret government task force set up to deal with unruly extraterrestrials. An MIB agent turns to the only man who can help him save the world from a rampaging, shape-shifting alien which has taken on the outward appearance of a sexy lingerie model.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Men in Black 3
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Agent J goes back to the swinging 60s in a time-travelling mission to save his partner from a murderous alien.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Perfect Storm
sky cinema thriller.desc: Seafaring drama based on the true story of a commercial fishing boat crew who become caught in a terrifying storm off the coast of Massachusetts. In the autumn of 1991, a fishing boat captain is determined to set sail despite the adverse weather conditions, but when the ice machine breaks down his decision to brave the storm rather than lose his catch results in a battle against 100ft waves.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Hunt for Red October
sky cinema thriller.desc: Soviet and American forces give chase when the captain of a Soviet nuclear submarine sets a course for the Maine coast.

sky cinema thriller.title: Red Dragon
sky cinema thriller.desc: Thriller adapted from Thomas Harris's first Hannibal Lecter novel about an FBI profiler called out of retirement to help catch a serial killer nicknamed the Tooth Fairy. The agent has the uncanny ability to project himself into the minds of his criminal prey, but the case forces him to confront his past and consult his former nemesis - the now-incarcerated Dr Hannibal Lecter.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Equalizer
sky cinema thriller.desc: A former commando who had faked his own death comes out of retirement to rescue a young girl from violent Russian mobsters.

sky cinema greats.title: Chaplin
sky cinema greats.desc: Re-creation of the life of comic genius Charlie Chaplin, from his humble beginnings in south London through his early days in British vaudeville, his silent movie career in America and his late masterpieces. His turbulent personal life saw four marriages and an enforced exile from the US - though he returned to receive an honorary Oscar in 1972.

sky cinema greats.title: Anatomy of a Murder
sky cinema greats.desc: Frederick Manion, an army lieutenant, is arrested for the murder of bartender, Barney Quill. In defence, he claims that the victim had beaten and raped his wife. With such evidence somewhat lacking, Manion's lawyer, Paul Biegler attempts to save his defendant from prosecution, setting his assistants in search of witnesses.

sky cinema greats.title: Clear and Present Danger
sky cinema greats.desc: Investigating the assassination of a friend of the President, CIA agent Ryan discovers that his friend was in league with the Colombian drugs cartels. In revenge, a paramilitary force is sent in to wipe out the drug lords but when the operation goes wrong, they're abandoned by their country. Now their only hope is Ryan and fellow renegade operative Clark.

sky cinema greats.title: The Shawshank Redemption
sky cinema greats.desc: Andy Dufresne and Ellis Boyd `Red' Redding are two prisoners serving long sentences in the vicious Shawshank jail. The two come to terms with their imprisonment while surviving the sadistic acts of prison warden Samuel Norton, and for both, a different sort of redemption awaits.

sky cinema drama.title: Valentine's Day
sky cinema drama.desc: Following a group of Los Angeles' residents who try to find their way through the highs and lows of love during a single day.

sky cinema drama.title: Air
sky cinema drama.desc: Sonny Vaccaro and Nike pursue basketball rookie Michael Jordan, creating a partnership that revolutionizes the world of sports and contemporary culture.

sky cinema drama.title: Almost Famous: Extended Edition
sky cinema drama.desc: In the 1970s, a 15-year-old boy gets the chance to live out his dream of touring with a band as a rock journalist. The son of a loving but strict single parent, the boy rebels against her distrust of rock music and the surrounding drug culture by writing album reviews which attract sponsorship from a big magazine to tour with a band. Ignoring all advice, he befriends band members and groupies alike.
